title: Software Engineer
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix. Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself. Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers. Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them. Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next. Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes. You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments. We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in. Technical background You've built production software with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it. Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript. Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents. Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it. Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability. One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why. Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked. Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable. Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it. Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them. Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written. Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work. Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to. Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. title: Data Scientist (3-5 years)
description: Data Scientist, real estate ontology MRI Software is hiring Data Scientists to turn a real estate ontology into products: the models, agents and analytics that only become possible when every property, lease, tenant, asset and transaction is described in one shared, machine-readable language. About the role MRI is building a Common Data Model that unifies data across its product portfolio. On top of it we are creating a real estate ontology: the entities, relationships, rules and semantics of the industry. You will be among the first data scientists to work on that foundation. Your job is to discover what can be built on it, prove it with working models and prototypes, and hand the winners to product teams. This is a research-to-product role. Expect to spend as much time finding the right problem as solving it. What you will do Help turn the Common Data Model into a real estate ontology: entities, relationships, constraints and business rules across leasing, property operations, assets, investments, and facilities. Explore the ontology with data to find high-value solutions: forecasting, anomaly detection, entity resolution, Decision modeling / recommendation, valuation signals, and portfolio optimization. Build and validate models on real product data from across the MRI portfolio, with clear baselines and honest evaluation. Prototype ontology-grounded AI: knowledge-graph retrieval, LLM agents that reason over typed entities, and natural-language analytics with a semantic layer. Define metrics and a semantic layer so that a number means the same thing in every product. Partner with product, engineering and domain experts to move proven prototypes into the MRI platform. Raise the bar on data quality: find mapping gaps, bad joins and silent failures, and feed them back into the model. What you bring Required Bachelor's or master's or PhD (from Premier Institute) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics or a related quantitative field 3-5 years of applied data science experience Strong foundations in statistics, probability, optimization and machine learning, and the judgment to know when a simple model is enough. Fluent Python and SQL; comfort with modern data stacks (Spark, a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt or similar). Hands-on experience with at least one of: knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic modelling, entity resolution, or LLM-based applications (retrieval, agents, evaluation). Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong plus Experience in real estate, proptech, finance, or any other asset-heavy domains. (preferred not mandatory) Published research, patents, competition results, or open-source work. Experience taking a model from notebook to production with MLOps practices. About Us From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you! Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people. We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day. At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze. From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients. Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge? We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you! We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more. We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About Us: At Leapcodes, we engineer digital solutions that help businesses innovate, modernize and scale. Our work spans Brand Marketing, Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity and Managed Services, serving customers across industries and geographies. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer who thinks beyond code, understands products, cares about user experience and takes ownership of engineering outcomes. This is an opportunity for engineers who want to build great products today and evolve into Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who solve real-world enterprise challenges through hands-on engineering. What You’ll Do * Engineer exceptional user experiences: Build intuitive, responsive and high-performance applications using React and Next.js, with strong attention to usability, accessibility and frontend performance. * Design optimized backend systems: Develop secure, scalable and efficient APIs, services and integrations using Node.js, Express and modern frameworks such as Hono. * Build products end to end: Participate throughout the product lifecycle, from architecture and prototyping to development, testing, deployment and continuous improvement. * Work with modern data platforms: Design and optimize relational and NoSQL data models using PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB. * Engineer for the cloud: Build and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure or GCP, using containers, Kubernetes and modern DevOps practices. * Embrace AI-driven development: Leverage AI coding agents and AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve development speed, code quality, testing and delivery efficiency. * Apply AIDLC principles: Work within an AI-driven development lifecycle, including AI-assisted requirements analysis, design, implementation, validation and documentation, while maintaining strong engineering governance. * Own engineering quality: Write clean, maintainable and secure code, optimize application and API performance, and contribute to reliable production releases. * Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with product, design, cloud, DevOps and customer-facing teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. What We’re Looking For Core Technical Competencies * Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node.js. * Practical backend development experience using Express.js, with familiarity or exposure to Hono. * Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs, with sound knowledge of authentication, authorization, API security and performance optimization. * Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL and/or MongoDB, including database design and query optimization. * Familiarity with headless CMS platforms, preferably Strapi. * Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants or agentic coding tools, with an understanding of their capabilities, limitations and appropriate validation practices. Engineering Mindset * Prior product development experience is mandatory, with demonstrable contributions to production-grade software products. * Ability to balance excellent frontend user experiences with well-architected, optimized backend services. * Familiarity with AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) methodologies and AI-assisted software delivery practices. * Comfortable working with evolving requirements, solving complex problems and taking ownership rather than simply completing assigned tickets. * Strong communication, analytical thinking and collaborative problem-solving skills. Your Growth Path: Forward Deployed Engineering As you grow with Leapcodes, you’ll have the opportunity to evolve into a Forward Deployed Engineer, working closer to enterprise customers to understand business challenges, architect solutions, customize and integrate products, and drive successful production implementations. This path is ideal for engineers who enjoy combining deep technical expertise, product thinking, customer collaboration and end-to-end solution ownership. Why Join Leapcodes? * Work on meaningful digital engineering and cloud-native product initiatives. * Gain exposure to enterprise environments and diverse technology challenges. * Engineer with modern AI coding tools and emerging development methodologies. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams across software engineering, cloud, AI and DevOps. * Build a career that can progress from Full Stack Engineering to Forward Deployed Engineering. title: Cloud Finops Engineer
description: Job Title: Cloud FinOps Engineer Experience: 5+ Years Work Mode: Remote Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Company Overview Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. Our commitment to state-of-the-art solutions spans the entire product value chain, delivering next-generation software, end-to-end IoT solutions, cloud infrastructure management, and managed IT support services. About the Role We are looking for a Cloud FinOps Engineer to own the design, development, and ongoing operation of a cloud cost and billing data platform. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a reporting-only or data-science position. You will build reliable, recurring pipelines that ingest cloud billing and usage data, transform it into accurate and auditable cost models, and make it available through dashboards and other business-facing tools. The role requires a combination of data engineering, cloud cost management, SQL/Python, commercial billing logic, security, and financial-data discipline. You will work in a highly autonomous environment where you are expected to make sound technical decisions, handle ambiguity, and build systems that remain reliable as billing periods, cloud services, SKUs, pricing models, and customer requirements evolve. Key Responsibilities 1. Cloud Billing & Cost Data Engineering Design and build production-grade pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and store cloud cost and usage data. Work with billing exports such as: o AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) o Azure Cost Management exports o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Cost and Usage Reports o Google Cloud Billing exports Build reusable data models for cloud spend, usage, pricing, discounts, allocations, and customer-level cost visibility. Normalize complex billing data into clean and maintainable schemas suitable for downstream reporting and commercial use. Handle large-volume billing datasets while maintaining accuracy, traceability, and performance. 2. Recurring Billing-Cycle Pipelines Design pipelines that reliably process new billing data on a recurring monthly/daily cycle without manual intervention. Build pipelines with appropriate idempotency, validation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms. Account for real-world billing-data changes such as: oNew cloud services or SKUs oSchema changes oMissing or delayed records oChanges in pricing structures oNew cost categories oPreviously unseen usage patterns Ensure that pipelines continue to operate correctly as cloud providers and billing exports evolve. Distinguish between one-time ETL work and genuinely maintainable, recurring production pipelines. 3. SQL & Data Modeling Write advanced SQL for complex transformations, reconciliations, aggregations, and cost allocation. Design and maintain appropriate schemas, tables, relationships, and data models. Build logic that supports accurate customer, service, account, resource, and cost-level analysis. Perform data validation and reconciliation to identify discrepancies between source billing data and processed outputs. Optimize queries and data structures for performance and maintainability. 4. Python & Automation Use Python or an equivalent scripting language to automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and operational tasks. Develop clean, reusable, maintainable code rather than one-off scripts. Automate recurring billing workflows and reduce manual intervention wherever practical. Implement appropriate logging, exception handling, validation, and auditability. 5. ETL / Orchestration Build and maintain data pipelines using tools such as Airflow, dbt, or equivalent orchestration and transformation frameworks. Where heavy tooling is unnecessary, demonstrate the ability to build reliable pipelines using simpler, well-engineered approaches. Define appropriate pipeline dependencies, schedules, retries, failure handling, and data-quality checks. Maintain clear separation between raw, transformed, and business-ready datasets. 6. Cloud Cost Allocation & Commercial Logic Translate cloud pricing structures and commercial agreements into accurate computational logic. Work with rate cards, discount structures, pricing tiers, minimum commitments, markups, and allocation rules. Understand the difference between provider cost, allocated cost, and customer-facing/commercial cost. Validate that pricing logic accurately reflects contractual terms. Identify and escalate ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting commercial requirements rather than making unsupported assumptions. Build auditable calculations that can be traced back to source data and applicable pricing rules. 7. Data Security & Multi-Tenant Architecture Design and maintain secure data models for multi-tenant cloud cost environments. Ensure proprietary cost and pricing information is appropriately segregated between customers, internal users, and other stakeholders. Implement or work with controls such as: o Row-level security o Field-level masking o Role-based access control o Data segregation o Secure data access Understand the security implications of exposing billing, pricing, margin, or contractual information to different audiences. Maintain appropriate auditability and access controls around sensitive financial data. 8. BI & Dashboarding Make processed cost and usage data available through BI and visualization platforms such as: o Looker o Power BI o Metabase o Tableau Develop or support dashboards for cloud spend, usage, allocation, trends, and cost analysis. Ensure dashboard outputs are backed by reliable and well-defined underlying data models. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business questions into meaningful data views. 9. Spreadsheet-Based Financial Modeling Use spreadsheets effectively for rate-card modeling, reconciliations, pricing calculations, validation, and ad hoc commercial analysis. Build formula-driven and auditable spreadsheet models rather than relying on hardcoded outputs. Ensure spreadsheet calculations can be reviewed, understood, and handed over to non-technical stakeholders. Reconcile spreadsheet outputs against system-generated data where required. 10. Billing Accuracy, Reconciliation & Auditability Develop mechanisms to reconcile processed billing data against source cloud-provider data. Investigate discrepancies and identify the underlying cause. Maintain clear data lineage from raw billing records transformation logic allocated cost customer-facing output. Support billing investigations, disputes, and audit requirements where necessary. Maintain sufficient evidence and documentation to explain how cost figures were calculated. 11. Documentation & System Ownership Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, business rules, pricing logic, access controls, and operational procedures. Maintain runbooks for recurring billing operations and failure scenarios. Document assumptions, dependencies, known limitations, and data-quality considerations. Take ownership of systems from initial design through production operation and continuous improvement. Must-Have Qualifications Technical Skills 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, cloud FinOps, cloud cost engineering, billing systems, platform engineering, or a closely related field. Strong intermediate-to-advanced SQL skills, including schema design, complex transformations, joins, aggregations, and data modeling. Strong Python or equivalent scripting experience. Hands-on experience building and operating production data pipelines. Experience with at least one major cloud provider's billing/cost data: o AWS CUR o Azure Cost Management o OCI Cost and Usage Reports o GCP Billing exports Experience with ETL/ELT and pipeline orchestration, using tools such as Airflow, dbt, or equivalent. Experience designing recurring production pipelines, preferably involving monthly billing cycles. Experience with at least one BI/dashboarding platform such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase, or Tableau. Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and auditability. Experience working with multi-tenant data and access-control requirements. Understanding of row-level security, field-level masking, or equivalent data-segregation mechanisms. Ability to understand commercial pricing structures and translate rate cards, discounts, pricing tiers, and minimum commitments into technical logic. Strong technical documentation skills. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Direct experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Experience in an MSP, cloud reseller, hosting provider, or managed-services environment. Experience managing cloud cost pass-through or customer billing. Experience working in an early-stage, resource-constrained, or highly autonomous environment. Experience with SSO / SAML integrations. Experience handling billing disputes, financial-data audits, or data lineage requirements. Experience with FinOps frameworks, cloud cost optimization, or cloud financial management practices. Relevant cloud or FinOps certifications. What We're Looking For The successful candidate is someone who can own the problem end-to-end. You should be comfortable moving from: Raw cloud billing export Data ingestion Transformation Cost allocation Commercial logic Validation Secure data access Dashboard / business output You should also be comfortable asking: What happens when the next billing cycle introduces a new SKU? How will the pipeline behave if the same export is processed twice? How do we identify missing or duplicated billing records? How do we reconcile our calculated costs against the provider's bill? Which customers should be able to see which cost information? How do we translate a discount clause in a contract into deterministic calculation logic? How can another engineer understand and operate this system six months from now? Key Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by the ability to: Build and maintain reliable recurring billing-data pipelines. Process new billing cycles with minimal manual intervention. Maintain accurate and auditable cost calculations. Detect and handle schema changes, new SKUs, and unexpected billing data. Maintain secure separation of customer and proprietary cost information. Translate commercial pricing requirements into correct technical logic. Provide trustworthy data for dashboards and downstream billing processes. Clearly document the system so that it can be maintained and operated independently. Identify problems proactively and make sound technical decisions with limited supervision. Why This Role Matters This role will form a critical part of the organization's cloud cost and billing infrastructure. The systems you build will directly influence the accuracy of cost allocation, commercial calculations, customer-facing information, and internal financial visibility. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys building systems from the ground up, solving ambiguous data problems, and taking full ownership of a technically and commercially important platform.

title: Cloud Finops Engineer
description: Job Title: Cloud FinOps Engineer Experience: 5+ Years Work Mode: Remote Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Company Overview Nuventure Connect is an ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified technology services company that leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and empower clients worldwide. About the Role We are looking for a Cloud FinOps Engineer to own the design, development, and ongoing operation of a cloud cost and billing data platform. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a reporting-only or data-science position. You will build reliable, recurring pipelines that ingest cloud billing and usage data, transform it into accurate and auditable cost models, and make it available through dashboards and other business-facing tools. The role requires a combination of data engineering, cloud cost management, SQL/Python, commercial billing logic, security, and financial-data discipline. You will work in a highly autonomous environment where you are expected to make sound technical decisions, handle ambiguity, and build systems that remain reliable as billing periods, cloud services, SKUs, pricing models, and customer requirements evolve. Key Responsibilities 1. Cloud Billing & Cost Data Engineering Design and build production-grade pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and store cloud cost and usage data. Work with billing exports such as: o AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) o Azure Cost Management exports o Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Cost and Usage Reports o Google Cloud Billing exports Build reusable data models for cloud spend, usage, pricing, discounts, allocations, and customer-level cost visibility. Normalize complex billing data into clean and maintainable schemas suitable for downstream reporting and commercial use. Handle large-volume billing datasets while maintaining accuracy, traceability, and performance. 2. Recurring Billing-Cycle Pipelines Design pipelines that reliably process new billing data on a recurring monthly/daily cycle without manual intervention. Build pipelines with appropriate idempotency, validation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms. Account for real-world billing-data changes such as: oNew cloud services or SKUs oSchema changes oMissing or delayed records oChanges in pricing structures oNew cost categories oPreviously unseen usage patterns Ensure that pipelines continue to operate correctly as cloud providers and billing exports evolve. Distinguish between one-time ETL work and genuinely maintainable, recurring production pipelines. 3. SQL & Data Modeling Write advanced SQL for complex transformations, reconciliations, aggregations, and cost allocation. Design and maintain appropriate schemas, tables, relationships, and data models. Build logic that supports accurate customer, service, account, resource, and cost-level analysis. Perform data validation and reconciliation to identify discrepancies between source billing data and processed outputs. Optimize queries and data structures for performance and maintainability. 4. Python & Automation Use Python or an equivalent scripting language to automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and operational tasks. Develop clean, reusable, maintainable code rather than one-off scripts. Automate recurring billing workflows and reduce manual intervention wherever practical. Implement appropriate logging, exception handling, validation, and auditability. 5. ETL / Orchestration Build and maintain data pipelines using tools such as Airflow, dbt, or equivalent orchestration and transformation frameworks. Where heavy tooling is unnecessary, demonstrate the ability to build reliable pipelines using simpler, well-engineered approaches. Define appropriate pipeline dependencies, schedules, retries, failure handling, and data-quality checks. Maintain clear separation between raw, transformed, and business-ready datasets. 6. Cloud Cost Allocation & Commercial Logic Translate cloud pricing structures and commercial agreements into accurate computational logic. Work with rate cards, discount structures, pricing tiers, minimum commitments, markups, and allocation rules. Understand the difference between provider cost, allocated cost, and customer-facing/commercial cost. Validate that pricing logic accurately reflects contractual terms. Identify and escalate ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting commercial requirements rather than making unsupported assumptions. Build auditable calculations that can be traced back to source data and applicable pricing rules. 7. Data Security & Multi-Tenant Architecture Design and maintain secure data models for multi-tenant cloud cost environments. Ensure proprietary cost and pricing information is appropriately segregated between customers, internal users, and other stakeholders. Implement or work with controls such as: o Row-level security o Field-level masking o Role-based access control o Data segregation o Secure data access Understand the security implications of exposing billing, pricing, margin, or contractual information to different audiences. Maintain appropriate auditability and access controls around sensitive financial data. 8. BI & Dashboarding Make processed cost and usage data available through BI and visualization platforms such as: o Looker o Power BI o Metabase o Tableau Develop or support dashboards for cloud spend, usage, allocation, trends, and cost analysis. Ensure dashboard outputs are backed by reliable and well-defined underlying data models. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business questions into meaningful data views. 9. Spreadsheet-Based Financial Modeling Use spreadsheets effectively for rate-card modeling, reconciliations, pricing calculations, validation, and ad hoc commercial analysis. Build formula-driven and auditable spreadsheet models rather than relying on hardcoded outputs. Ensure spreadsheet calculations can be reviewed, understood, and handed over to non-technical stakeholders. Reconcile spreadsheet outputs against system-generated data where required. 10. Billing Accuracy, Reconciliation & Auditability Develop mechanisms to reconcile processed billing data against source cloud-provider data. Investigate discrepancies and identify the underlying cause. Maintain clear data lineage from raw billing records transformation logic allocated cost customer-facing output. Support billing investigations, disputes, and audit requirements where necessary. Maintain sufficient evidence and documentation to explain how cost figures were calculated. 11. Documentation & System Ownership Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for pipelines, schemas, business rules, pricing logic, access controls, and operational procedures. Maintain runbooks for recurring billing operations and failure scenarios. Document assumptions, dependencies, known limitations, and data-quality considerations. Take ownership of systems from initial design through production operation and continuous improvement. Must-Have Qualifications Technical Skills 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, cloud FinOps, cloud cost engineering, billing systems, platform engineering, or a closely related field. Strong intermediate-to-advanced SQL skills, including schema design, complex transformations, joins, aggregations, and data modeling. Strong Python or equivalent scripting experience. Hands-on experience building and operating production data pipelines. Experience with at least one major cloud provider's billing/cost data: o AWS CUR o Azure Cost Management o OCI Cost and Usage Reports o GCP Billing exports Experience with ETL/ELT and pipeline orchestration, using tools such as Airflow, dbt, or equivalent. Experience designing recurring production pipelines, preferably involving monthly billing cycles. Experience with at least one BI/dashboarding platform such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase, or Tableau. Strong understanding of data quality, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and auditability. Experience working with multi-tenant data and access-control requirements. Understanding of row-level security, field-level masking, or equivalent data-segregation mechanisms. Ability to understand commercial pricing structures and translate rate cards, discounts, pricing tiers, and minimum commitments into technical logic. Strong technical documentation skills. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Direct experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Experience in an MSP, cloud reseller, hosting provider, or managed-services environment. Experience managing cloud cost pass-through or customer billing. Experience working in an early-stage, resource-constrained, or highly autonomous environment. Experience with SSO / SAML integrations. Experience handling billing disputes, financial-data audits, or data lineage requirements. Experience with FinOps frameworks, cloud cost optimization, or cloud financial management practices. Relevant cloud or FinOps certifications. What We're Looking For The successful candidate is someone who can own the problem end-to-end. You should be comfortable moving from: Raw cloud billing export Data ingestion Transformation Cost allocation Commercial logic Validation Secure data access Dashboard / business output You should also be comfortable asking: What happens when the next billing cycle introduces a new SKU? How will the pipeline behave if the same export is processed twice? How do we identify missing or duplicated billing records? How do we reconcile our calculated costs against the provider's bill? Which customers should be able to see which cost information? How do we translate a discount clause in a contract into deterministic calculation logic? How can another engineer understand and operate this system six months from now? Key Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by the ability to: Build and maintain reliable recurring billing-data pipelines. Process new billing cycles with minimal manual intervention. Maintain accurate and auditable cost calculations. Detect and handle schema changes, new SKUs, and unexpected billing data. Maintain secure separation of customer and proprietary cost information. Translate commercial pricing requirements into correct technical logic. Provide trustworthy data for dashboards and downstream billing processes. Clearly document the system so that it can be maintained and operated independently. Identify problems proactively and make sound technical decisions with limited supervision. Why This Role Matters This role will form a critical part of the organization's cloud cost and billing infrastructure. The systems you build will directly influence the accuracy of cost allocation, commercial calculations, customer-facing information, and internal financial visibility. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys building systems from the ground up, solving ambiguous data problems, and taking full ownership of a technically and commercially important platform.

title: Senior Database Engineer – SQL/NoSQL (Development & Architecture)
description: About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Database Engineer to take ownership of our database systems, including the development, architecture, optimization, administration, and maintenance of both SQL and NoSQL databases. This is a hands-on technical role combining the responsibilities of a Database Developer, Database Administrator, and Database Architect. The ideal candidate must be capable of designing complex, scalable database architectures from the ground up while also possessing strong programming skills to develop and optimize stored procedures, complex queries, functions, scripts, and other database components. You will work closely with software architects, backend developers, DevOps engineers, and project teams to ensure that our database systems are secure, reliable, highly available, and optimized for performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Database Architecture & Design Design and architect highly scalable, secure, and efficient SQL and NoSQL database solutions for complex enterprise applications. Evaluate project requirements and determine the most appropriate database technologies and architectural approaches. Design logical and physical data models, relational schemas, document structures, relationships, and indexing strategies. Define database architecture for high-volume transactional applications, distributed systems, and microservices. Implement database design principles including normalization, denormalization, partitioning, replication, and sharding where appropriate. Design solutions for high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and horizontal/vertical scaling. Establish database architecture standards, documentation, and best practices across projects. 2. Database Development & Programming Develop, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and database scripts. Write efficient T-SQL, PL/pgSQL, or equivalent database programming code. Develop database-level logic and data processing routines for complex application requirements. Implement efficient data retrieval, transformation, validation, and manipulation operations. Design and maintain database migration scripts, schema changes, and data correction utilities. Optimize existing database code for performance, maintainability, and reliability. Review database scripts and SQL code developed by other engineers. Troubleshoot complex database programming issues and resolve data inconsistencies. 3. SQL & NoSQL Database Expertise Work extensively with relational databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Design, develop, and maintain NoSQL databases such as MongoDB and Amazon DynamoDB. Understand and apply SQL versus NoSQL architectural patterns based on application requirements. Implement appropriate indexing, query optimization, and data modeling strategies for both relational and non-relational databases. Design efficient document schemas, collections, partition keys, and data access patterns. Work with caching technologies such as Redis where applicable. Evaluate trade-offs involving transactions, consistency, availability, scalability, and performance. 4. Database Administration & Maintenance Manage and maintain existing production, staging, and development database environments. Proactively monitor database health, availability, performance, storage utilization, and resource consumption. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, locking issues, inefficient queries, and connection problems. Establish and maintain automated database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures. Perform database upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and routine health checks. Implement appropriate database security controls, encryption, access management, and audit logging. Ensure database integrity, consistency, reliability, and data protection. Conduct root cause analysis of database incidents and implement preventive measures. 5. Performance Optimization & Scalability Analyze execution plans, query performance, indexing strategies, and database resource utilization. Optimize database schemas, stored procedures, queries, and data access patterns for improved application performance. Design scalable solutions capable of handling high transaction volumes and increasing data workloads. Implement query optimization, connection pooling, replication, and partitioning strategies where appropriate. Perform database capacity planning and identify opportunities for infrastructure and cost optimization. Recommend architectural improvements to address emerging performance and scalability challenges. 6. Cloud Database Management & Automation Work with cloud-hosted and managed database services, particularly on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Manage services such as Amazon RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, Azure SQL Database, or equivalent platforms. Develop automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies for database maintenance and operational tasks. Collaborate with DevOps engineers to implement automated database deployments and infrastructure improvements. Integrate database schema changes and migrations into CI/CD pipelines. Support database migration between on-premises, cloud-hosted, and managed database environments. 7. Technical Collaboration & Engineering Standards Collaborate with software architects, backend engineers, and technical leads during solution design and implementation. Participate in architecture discussions and recommend suitable database technologies and designs. Review database architecture and SQL/NoSQL implementations across projects. Define coding standards, database development guidelines, and performance optimization practices. Maintain documentation covering database structures, configurations, dependencies, and recovery procedures. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to software developers on database best practices. Take ownership of complex database-related technical challenges and drive them through resolution. Expert-level SQL programming and query optimization. Advanced experience with stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and database scripts. Strong understanding of indexing, execution plans, transactions, locking, concurrency, and performance tuning. Experience designing relational schemas for complex enterprise applications. NoSQL Databases (Mandatory) Hands-on production experience with at least one major NoSQL database, preferably MongoDB or DynamoDB. Strong understanding of NoSQL data modeling, query patterns, indexing, and scalability. Experience designing and optimizing NoSQL databases for real-world application requirements. Understanding of consistency models, partitioning, replication, and distributed data management. Database Architecture (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience independently designing database architectures for medium-to-large or complex applications. Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL architectural patterns. Experience with high-availability, replication, disaster recovery, and scalable database solutions. Ability to evaluate and recommend suitable database technologies based on functional and non-functional requirements. Experience with cloud-hosted database architecture. Database Operations (Mandatory) Production database administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Database backup and restoration, including recovery testing. Database security, role-based access control, and data integrity. Database performance monitoring and capacity planning. Safe production schema migrations and deployment practices. Programming & Automation Advanced SQL/T-SQL/PL/pgSQL or equivalent database programming skills. Experience with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting languages. Experience with Git, version-controlled database scripts, and database deployment automation. Preferred Qualifications 7+ years of relevant professional experience in database engineering, development, architecture, or administration. Strong, verifiable production experience with both SQL and NoSQL technologies. Experience architecting database solutions for enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, or high-volume transactional systems. Experience working with .NET, Node.js, or other backend development ecosystems. Familiarity with microservices architecture, REST/GraphQL APIs, and distributed systems. Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP database services. Experience with database migration, modernization, and performance improvement initiatives. Familiarity with database observability tools and cloud monitoring services. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Key Competencies Strong architectural thinking combined with hands-on programming ability. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently own database-related technical decisions. Strong understanding of application performance and database dependencies. Ability to balance scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost. Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Proactive approach to identifying and preventing production database issues.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: Senior Analytics Engineer, Developer Productivity & DevSecOps About the role We are looking for an Senior Analytics Engineer to build and maintain the data pipelines, metrics, dashboards, and reports that measure the impact of our DevSecOps transformation program on the developer community. This role combines data engineering, analytics, and reporting with an understanding of how software is developed and delivered. You will work with program leaders, development teams, platform teams, and data engineering teams to turn data from developer tools and enterprise systems into reliable insights. Your work will help us understand tool adoption, guide migrations between platforms, identify delivery bottlenecks, and evaluate changes in developer productivity, software quality, and operational reliability. You will deliver rapid reporting prototypes, develop maintained reporting solutions, and serve as the curator of our metric definitions. Key responsibilities Build dashboards and reports. Develop and maintain Power BI reporting across software delivery performance, developer activity, tool adoption, onboarding, quality, reliability, and AI tool usage. Deliver rapid prototypes. Respond quickly to emerging questions with practical Excel analyses, preliminary dashboards, and reports built from available data. Convert CSV and JSON extracts into usable reporting, validate initial findings, and refine requirements with stakeholders. Develop prototypes into maintained solutions where needed. Discover and understand data sources. Identify the systems, APIs, tables, and extracts needed to answer reporting questions. Understand how source data is generated, what it represents, and the limitations that affect its use. Build and coordinate data pipelines. Use Python, SQL, and appropriate platform capabilities to extract, transform, and load reporting data. Partner with Databricks and other data engineering teams when they own upstream pipelines, and help resolve data access, integration, and refresh issues. Develop consistent data models and calculations. Combine data across systems, reconcile developer identities, connect activity to organizational structures, and implement consistent reporting populations, time periods, and calculation logic. Measure adoption and migration. Establish tool usage baselines, track movement from existing platforms to replacements, and identify adoption gaps, inactive users, and opportunities to improve license utilization. Analyze development and delivery workflows. Engineer DORA and related metrics, including deployment frequency, lead time for changes, coding and review times, commit activity, pull request and merge request activity, and work progress captured in Jira. Evaluate AI adoption and outcomes. Report on access, engagement, and usage of AI development tools. Use appropriate baseline, trend, and group comparisons to assess relationships between adoption and development outcomes. Own and curate metric definitions. Maintain a shared metric dictionary covering each measure’s purpose, calculation, data sources, reporting population, time periods, exclusions, assumptions, and limitations. Coordinate agreement on definitions and manage changes to preserve consistency. Explain and interpret the metrics. Serve as the point of reference for what each metric means, how it is calculated, and how it should be used. Investigate questions about reported figures and explain findings clearly to technical and business audiences. Maintain reporting reliability. Validate accuracy, completeness, and freshness; investigate discrepancies; troubleshoot failed pipelines and report refreshes; maintain appropriate access controls; and document how reported measures trace back to their sources. Required skills and experience Power BI: Practical experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data models, including DAX, Power Query, scheduled refreshes, and row level security. SQL: Strong ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize queries involving complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and time based calculations. Databricks: Experience querying and preparing data, working with Unity Catalog catalogs, schemas, tables, and views, and collaborating with teams responsible for data access and pipelines. Python: Practical experience extracting, cleaning, transforming, and validating data, integrating with APIs, and automating recurring data processes. Data integration and modeling: Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, combining data from multiple systems, and working with API authentication, CSV files, and JSON data. Excel: Proficiency in importing and transforming extracts, preparing and reconciling data, and building prototype analyses and reports using Power Query, formulas, and pivot tables. Software development lifecycle: Intermediate understanding of Git version control, commits, branching, pull requests, merge requests, code review, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployments. Ability to connect these workflows to the data used to measure them. Analytical judgment: Ability to define meaningful measures, validate assumptions, distinguish activity and adoption from outcomes, and explain what the available evidence supports. Responsiveness and ownership: Ability to work with incomplete or evolving requirements, deliver useful initial analyses quickly, apply appropriate validation, and carry reporting work through delivery and ongoing maintenance. Communication and collaboration: Ability to translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, coordinate across teams, document definitions and decisions, and explain calculations and findings clearly. Preferred skills and experience Familiarity with reporting data from Jira, GitLab, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Databricks Assistant, ServiceNow, workforce systems, or learning management systems. Experience measuring developer productivity, DevSecOps transformation, software delivery performance, or technology adoption. Experience working with Excel, CSV, and other supplemental reporting inputs stored in SharePoint. Experience using AI coding assistants such as Codex to accelerate data manipulation, Python and SQL development, analysis, and reporting automation, with the ability to review and validate generated code and outputs. What success looks like Stakeholders receive timely, useful reporting supported by dependable data processes and clearly defined metrics. Emerging questions can be answered quickly through validated prototypes, and recurring needs become maintained reporting solutions. Reported figures can be traced to their sources, definitions are consistently understood, and insights help teams make informed decisions about the DevSecOps transformation program.
